title: Fix crash for unknown and mixed-case usernames

changed_files.patch:
@@ -1,9 +1,12 @@
 USERS = {"ada": {"name": "Ada"}}
 
 
 def find_user(username):
-    return USERS.get(username)
+    return USERS.get(username.lower())
 
 
 def greeting(username):
-    return "Hello, " + USERS[username]["name"]
+    user = find_user(username)
+    if user is None:
+        return "Hello, stranger!"
+    return "Hello, " + user["name"]

@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+from demo.user_service import greeting
+
+
+def test_greeting_is_case_insensitive():
+    assert greeting("ADA") == "Hello, Ada"
